integration_context.note: This isolated projection branch predates the separately integrated sequence-scratch fix; its KV formulas are unaffected.

excludes: peak old plus new allocation while ResidentSession grows capacity
process RSS, swap, and device measurements

current_expanded.description: One fully expanded key and value per attention head plus one DSA index key for every layer/token.

compact_mla.description: Literal replacement of expanded keys/values with one normalized KV latent and shared rotated RoPE tail, while retaining the current all-78-layer DSA index-key allocation.

maximally_compact_mla.description: Compact MLA plus DSA index-key storage owned only by the 21 full-indexer layers. The 57 shared-indexer layers reuse the selected index and never read or write their currently allocated index-key buffers.

capacity_semantics: The helper mirrors the live ResidentRuntime: initial capacity is 64 tokens; growth above 64 rounds required tokens to the next power of two. Arithmetic and next-power-of-two growth are checked. The projection is steady-state and excludes the peak old-plus-new allocation while each layer grows.
source_alignment: ResidentRuntime::new and the projection helper share RESIDENT_RUNTIME_INITIAL_KV_CAPACITY_TOKENS=64; factoring the existing literal through this constant does not change runtime behavior or defaults.

architectural_change_required_for_32k.cache: Replace LayerGpuCache's expanded per-head keys and values with per-layer arrays for the normalized 512-wide KV latent and shared 64-wide rotated RoPE tail. For the maximal floor, assign 128-wide DSA index-key storage only to the 21 full-indexer layers and make the 57 shared layers reuse that owner instead of allocating unused per-layer buffers.
architectural_change_required_for_32k.attention: Rewrite sparse attention to consume compact MLA state: use the fixed kv_b/o_proj factors in an absorbed formulation or reconstruct only the selected positions on device, while preserving Numeric Parity V2.1 discrete decisions and gating continuous drift.
architectural_change_required_for_32k.sequence_scratch: Implemented separately on live main by 27fe89b5, with durable receipt 3f8a4e04. This projection branch intentionally does not duplicate that patch.
architectural_change_required_for_32k.necessity: The current 32K expanded KV/index floor alone is 313.21875 GiB, before weights or scratch, so it cannot fit a 96-GiB host. With sequence scratch already repaired separately, the remaining architectural necessity is the compact MLA cache plus its attention rewrite; eliminating unused shared-layer index-key buffers lowers the literal 6.703125-GiB compact result to a maximal 5.8125-GiB static floor. Both are static projections requiring measured end-to-end validation.
